children.value: The reservoir model simulates water storage reservoirs with optional integrated aeration systems. It provides water storage capacity and can perform gas transfer processes to improve water quality through CO₂ removal, oxygen addition, and methane stripping.
The reservoir model inherits from the base
class and functions as both a storage unit and a treatment process when integrated aeration is enabled.
In basic storage mode, the reservoir simply stores water without treatment:

children.html: Reservoirstored=Influentwater\text{Reservoir}_{stored} = \text{Influent}_{water}Reservoirstored​=Influentwater​
